in_sanskrit.name: ईश्वरी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: She who is the goddess, the female form of Ishwar, the ruler and controller of the universe.

in_hindi.name: इश्वरी
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ishwar ki patni, wife of Ishwar

in_tamil.name: இஷ்வரி
in_tamil.long_meaning: Ishvaran iruvan, one who is Ishvaran

in_marathi.name: Ishwari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ishwari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ishwari is a Sanskrit name derived from the word Ishwar, meaning God or Supreme Being. The name Ishwari signifies the Goddess who pervades the entire universe. She is the source of all creation, preservation, and destruction. Ishwari is also known as Mahamaya, the great illusionist, who creates the world through her Maya or divine power.
